body:
Adds Grave Accord's cooperative game loop with 66 boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. Offline Solo, public/private rooms, profiles, encounter-boundary saves and persistent server-scoped team records are implemented.

Players prepare equipment in a waiting room and the host starts manually. Rooms have copyable codes and optional enforced passwords; protected public listings show a lock. Codes stay within menu flow instead of covering vote/shop timers. The player card uses actual character headshots, separate health/shield bars and clear resources. Setup labels have stronger contrast and random-map choices show all six maps. Both public and testing share the presentation.

Chat keeps a draft until the server confirms delivery, explains rejections, preserves edits and safely retries uncertain sends after reconnect without duplicate broadcasts. IME composition is guarded and recent history returns after rapid chat toggles. C opens and closes chat, with menu upgrades scrolling above a separate action row. Solo pauses; online matches continue while menus are open.

Loading now offers Cancel/Esc and keeps keyboard focus with that action. Cancelling stops health/search/retry/worker startup, queued admission and pending SDK HTTP/socket joins. A late connection or asset callback cannot overwrite a newer screen. Room search preserves version, address, rate-limit, expired-code and full/closed-room errors with plain notices in all fifteen languages. Leaving setup/online records or changing filters cancels their board/roster requests, while pagination preserves earlier rows. Actual delayed HTTP, stalled SDK WebSocket, ticket cleanup and compiled menu fixtures cover these paths.

A selected map stays fixed, with separate random-once and random-per-encounter choices. Painted cover and scenery cover all 36 map/difficulty combinations. Small Wakes bosses stay within floor bounds derived from their full painted frames, addressing Crab artwork crossing Triage Yard's edge. Boss clears retain the actual position/floor for five seconds with one sound, a preparation message and countdown; fifteen bosses have full falls and fifty-one have final poses.

Medic has finite two-second self/team recovery: Baby full health plus 20% shield, Easy 75%, Normal 45%, Hard 30%, Insane 1 HP and Hellish none. Other classes retain their restrictions. Passive regeneration is reduced 25% on Hard, 50% on Insane and disabled on Hellish. Combined personal shield capacity is 100% of maximum health on lower difficulties, 75% on Hard, 50% on Insane and zero on Hellish. Tank starts each fight at full capacity, Heavy at 50%, Soldier at 15%, others at zero. Future cap upgrades and selective blocking remain notes only.

Team records use authority-written results, shared scores/ties, historical participants, filters and paging. Test runs and client-submitted scores cannot enter the board. Shared deployed global rankings and durable match recovery remain release work.

Validation: source 49b3d5ad592e53181ce03fb165caa562ad14a083, build 2026.10.29-connection-clarity / protocol 42, passes 849/849/0 locally and in both exact-source CI jobs, plus TypeScript, authored content, fifteen locales, native artwork, production build and 71 atlas contracts. [CI 123792834905](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40972627940/job/123792834905) · [CI 123792784807](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40972612949/job/123792784807). Full logs, the failing baseline and acceptance limits: [connection review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/connection-clarity-2026-10-29). Wiki 064db30c8a559ea427cb4d20e1f7e3c36163c2f3 matches all 18 canonical pages and 34 images, including public hashes.

The prior local fe82c7e Windows review predates this connection/UI pass and passes all 1,899 files on original, fresh deep extraction and an independent Windows copy in a Japanese path, with six actual native offline/LAN diagnostics. Checks include 210 class/mode/difficulty starts and shield expectations, 67 music decodes, passwords, code join, host-only Start, confirmed/deduplicated chat, combat and shutdown. Its exact source also passes both CI jobs. Fresh frozen public 5239/backend 2613 and testing 5238/backend 2612 previews retain exact source 49b3d5a and each passes 33 served hashes, matching audience/worker, password/code/host-only Start, confirmed chat and server-record reads. Earlier previews remain preserved. No synthetic qualifying score was submitted.

The game remains in development. Rendered/human balance, full action art, device, listening, native-language, WAN/endurance/capacity and coordinated hosted release acceptance remain open. Earlier previews, artwork, failures and packages are preserved. The older protocol-4 Site and immutable protocol-13 published Windows download remain separate. This draft does not merge main, deploy the game, replace a release or submit the contest.
